newsitem.title: USA: BHC Financial stake held by Tyndall group.
newsitem.headline: BHC Financial stake held by Tyndall group.

text.p: A group led by Tyndall Partners L.P. said Thursday it holds a five percent stake in BHC Financial Inc or 317,700 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 38,603 shares bought between November 26 and January 10 at prices ranging from $15.06 to $16.03 per share.

BHC, based in Philadelphia, Pa., is a holding company providing cost effective and efficient trade execution, clearning, margin lending, customer account processing and other customized services to banks and other institutions.
